title: Build test strategy decision
description: The test-strategy-decider's decision on the strategy concerns a build's test specialist selection named as unresolved (strategyConflicts of build-selection.schema.json): one decision per concern, from the conflicting accepted evidence the selection cites, with its rationale and rejected alternatives. The test-design-lead then selects the test writers under these directives.

evidence.description: The paths of the accepted analyses the decision rests on.

writerDirectives.description: The decided strategy stated as constraints for the test writers.
